title: The People Who Made My Street
gist_ar: وصف لناس وأماكن في الشارع باستخدام العبارات الوصلية.
text:
I want to describe the street where I grew up, and the people who made it what it is.

There is a baker whose shop opens at four in the morning. He is the person who taught me that work can be quiet and proud. Next to him there is a small workshop where an old man repairs anything that has a motor. The tool which he uses most is a screwdriver that belonged to his father.

Opposite them lives a woman who came here as a stranger twenty years ago and who now knows every family. She is the neighbour that everybody calls when there is a problem.

At the end of the street there is a wall where the children write their names. The reason I love that wall is simple: it is the only place in the city which records that we were here.

A street is not the buildings. It is the people whose habits you can hear through the window.

Whose screwdriver does the old man use?

options: Everybody calls her when there is a problem

options: It records that they were here
